newsitem.title: ESTONIA: PENNU, W.DIGITAL TO PRESENT PLANS.
newsitem.headline: PENNU, W.DIGITAL TO PRESENT PLANS.

text.p: U.S. computer firm Western Digital and Pennu are to hold a press conference on June 18 to present an overview of Western Digital's development plans and cooperation with Pennu, the Estonian group said on Tuesday.
Pennu said in a statement that Western Digital's Eastern Europe sales manager Andres Kiep will present an overview of their cooperation.
"The press conference will clarify Western Digital's plans in Estonia," Lembit Abileid, Pennu managing director, told Reuters.

Pennu has been holding talks with Western Digital over the setting up of hard disc renovation centre in Estonia in cooperation with Western Digital, one of the world's largest computer hard disk producers.
